notes.title: Fixed: Beast Material Warehouse and Wildnuts

After receiving a report that the wildnut in the animal material warehouse was full and was not consumed, the animal material warehouse and wildnut were modified.

When the wildnut in the animal warehouse is full, it is not a bug by itself if it is not consumed.
If there is more affordable food nearby than the wildnut, the people will give priority to it.
In food-rich areas, beasts can be ignored and continue to accumulate.
However, it is programmed so that even if the warehouse is full, various problems will not occur.

However, apart from that, as a result of receiving a report and investigating,
We were able to discover a bug that the beasts could not recognize in the wildnut of the beast material warehouse.
(People seemed to be aware)
Thank you to those who reported! Thank you very much.

I fixed this immediately.

This will allow the beasts to recognize the wildnut in the beast material warehouse.
Some beasts can now steal them.

notes.title: Spring Update! March 19th,2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35081257/9deb74c521f13a44ff3aa3a85ebfddc86953e015.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!
Spring is coming in Japan and it is getting warmer little by little.
I'm excited about the arrival of spring, so I've updated it and will let you know!


[h2]The maximum number of grass, wood and stone storage areas has been increased to 20.[/h2]

Until now, they were only available in three spaces per square, but have been expanded to five spaces. As a result, a maximum of 20 items can be stored in one storage area.


[h2]Add various beasts![/h2]

Finally, non-deer beasts have begun to appear on your island.
It's a cute squirrel or a mischievous coyote!

They have their own nest and their own ecology.
They may steal the food of your islanders or devastate fields and warehouses to live.
It might be nice to enjoy watching their cute behavior.

But desperate to live is the same with the islanders.
You can deal with the beasts in "Hunter center".
Build a "Hunter center" near the beast's nest and hire hunters.

(By the way, new beasts will appear about 10 years after the start)
(Also, in "Island data" which has already pioneered most of the island, there is no space for nests to appear, so beasts may not appear)
(If you do not want the animals to appear, you can switch it off in <OPTION - CONFOG menu>)


[h3]"Hunter center" strengthened.[/h3]

Hunter center have been strengthened in line with the addition of beasts.
Hunter center can be upgraded to the second stage with bricks.
Furthermore, if you have bones, you can upgrade to the third stage.
The upgrade is up to the fifth stage, and the hunter increases the number of shootings with each upgrade.


[h3]Added a public building "Munitions depot"[/h3]

Building an "Munitions depot" increases "Hunter center" abilities within range.
"Munitions depot" is also available for upgrade to the second stage.



[h3]Other small adjustments[/h3]

Pallets now glow when new structures are added.

The image quality of people and items, which was the best when MAP was reduced to 1/2, was slightly improved. (Previously it was black and cloudy, but it has been eliminated)
I am very happy that this improvement has been made!

Crops are now seasonally affected.
Specifically, the number of harvests increased in summer and autumn, and the number of harvests decreased in winter. (The total number of harvests has increased than before.)

When building a building, each project now costs 1 Ark.
(In the case of roads, etc., 1 Ark is consumed per square. If the Ark is 0, construction is possible without consumption.)
Along with that, we increased the amount of Ark obtained in various places.

Employees are now delivering food to homes that are short on food when their products are full at a food factory facility.

Increased the food value of food factories in Very Easy mode to Normal mode by 10%.



That's it for this announcement.
I wish you a good spring!
Happy spring!

We introduced this for those who love numbers and graphs.

[h3]Add variations of brick house and small house[/h3]
We added six different appearance variations to "Brick House" and one variation to "Small House".
When you build a “brick house” or “small house”, sometimes these variations are randomly selected, and a different looking house is built.
Enjoy a slightly different look that occasionally appears!


[h3]Added "Robot Factory" construction[/h3]
robot! It is a dream of mankind!
At the end of the game, when you can make "Mythril",
"Robot Factory" has been added to the factory menu, and you can now make robots!
The manufactured robot behaves like a human.
And they have an average life expectancy of 200 years with iron mind and body!
Also, they have nothing to do with sickness or starvation! ! !
If your health drops to zero, you will not die.

But they also need energy.
They need twice as much food as humans.
Also, unlike humans, they have no gender and cannot marry or become pregnant.
As long as they can replenish the energy of their food, they will continue to work for 200 years on the island's troll! !
By the way, there are only 100 robots that can operate simultaneously on the island.
This is to prevent robots from conquering humanity.
If you right-click on the robot, the menu item "Destroy him" will appear in the menu.
In the unlikely event, you can destroy the robot by executing it.


[h3]Added "Cat House 2" construction[/h3]
I love cats! For those who are, "Cat House 2" has been added.
If you have already built Cat House, and the total number of children born on the island exceeds 300, Cat House will be automatically added to the event menu.
When you build this facility, calico cats will appear on the island! ! ! ! ! Meow! ! ! !


[h3]Add octopus[/h3]
It is unsatisfactory that a fisherman's hut angler only catches fish.
If you like angler rolls, you've probably thought so!
Therefore, fishermen in fisherman huts within the fishery union were able to catch octopus from time to time.
Octopus has a food value 10 higher than fish.
The caught octopus can be stored in a fish warehouse, just like fish.


[h3]Challenge "Limit Island" added[/h3]
This new challenge appears by clearing both the existing challenges, "Beanlike Island" and "Antlike Island".
Marginal Island is the smallest island to date and is prohibited from spreading land by land reclamation. It's a challenging challenge, worthy of the challenge of pushing the limits.



That's all for the update report.
I hope 2020 is a good year for you!

notes.title: Update! October 16th,2019
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35081257/ec81b72e09b280e9ebc5203fa81261e1f479db86.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!
It's almost Halloween!
Japan is getting colder little by little.

Here is a summary of updates that have been made since the beginning of October!


[h1]Key Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Construction [b]'Cacao tree'.[/b]
[*]Added Construction [b]'Chocolate shop'.[/b]
Chocolate! Life is not fun without this!
This game needed it too!
I would like to add various kinds of chocolates that chocolate shops can handle in the future.

[*]Added Event Construct 'Pumpkin face'
I added this item for people who want to make a lot of pumpkin fields and enjoy Halloween. Let's make the island covered with pumpkins!

[*]Added [b]"Bridge"[/b]
A bridge... The other side was always a dream of the people.
Clay mine workers were always looking to the other side and skipping work.
The time has finally come for me to cross the "opposite shore"!
Let's build a bridge!!

When specifying the construction location, you can select horizontal or vertical orientation with the T key.
Thank you to the user who made a great suggestion for the bridge!

[*]Added a [b]recipe [/b]change item to [b]the bakery[/b] menu.
I want to make more kinds of bread at a bakery!
I've added the following recipe to help people who love bread!
[b]・ Croissant
・ Sandwich
・ Corn bread[/b]
Each of these recipes has a different occurrence condition.
Please find it and make various kinds of bread.

[*]Added [b]Books unlock ranking[/b].
[*][b]'Product book' 'Treasure book' and 'Ruine Book'[/b] were added to the types of books.
For a book, you can click on the building to see an image of the building under construction.

[*]Added [b]culture Lv8[/b].
[*]Added [b]a new BGM[/b]. the total to 18 BGMs.
[/list]


[h1]Major feature additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Keyboard shortcut: [V] key now selects the Destroy Tool.
Thank you to the user who made this proposal! It's 100 times more convenient!

[*]With the destruction tool, you can change sandy areas with visible rock surfaces to green areas.
Once you change it to green, you can't return it to the sandy rock surface, so please be careful.

[*]When the railway is connected to the bridge, the trolley train started to run on the bridge.
Buildings 'Inada' are no longer damaged by fire.
[/list]

[h1]Major bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused title screens to display incorrectly on monitors larger than 1920 x 1080.
Thank you for the report from the user who used the large monitor!
[*]The bug in which the fuel values of wind turbines and hydroelectric power plants do not overlap was corrected.
[/list]

The full release is coming soon!
We will continue to update it.
Enjoy game 'Your Island -Kimi no sima-'

notes.title: September Update! 6th ,2019
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35081257/1730d17abeda3c6792093982bd54a65488a206c2.gif[/img]

Hello everyone.
It's the beginning of the new school term!
I updated a lot this week, so I will let you know!


[h1]Key Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Addition of buildings [b]'a pretty house', 'Orange Roof House'[/b] and [b]'Flower House'.[/b]
I want more variations of the house, and I also want cute ones!
In response to such voices, we added 3 kinds of nice houses.
It's a tasteful house like a town in the Mediterranean.
Make your island even cuter!

[*]Addition of a building [b]'hydroelectric power station' 'thermal power plant'.[/b]
It is difficult to supply the energy of the expanded island only with firewood and windmills.
So we added two hydroelectric and thermal power plants.
A hydroelectric power plant, simply installed on the waterside, constantly adds 20 more fuel to a range of facilities.
Thermal power plants also consume wood and constantly add 30 more fuel to a wide range of facilities.
Well, let's fill up the island's fuel!

[*]Add Construction [b]'Immigration Bureau'[/b]
If you want to regularly receive immigrants from other islands, you should build this facility.
One crystal is used at a time to authorize migrants.
Once in operation, a ship can be visited about once a year, allowing one to four migrants to enter the country.
Thanks to the users who suggested this idea!

[*]Add [b]Challenge Mode[/b]
A challenge mode has been added that aims to achieve the goal under certain conditions.
If you're in a difficult situation and have a desire to break through, give it a try.
The reward in challenge mode is also valid in regular games.
At in-game Achievement 15% and above, this mode is unlocked.

[*]Addition of Culture Lv7
[/list]
[h1]Functional Update[/h1]
[list]
[*]I can give instructions to my child. However, we cannot give instructions to children on their way to school.
As a result, the DESTORY tool was changed to include carpenters, Hijikata, and children in the selection of workers for logging.

[*]Changed keyboard pan to 1/4 of screen.
The size of the log in the lower left corner of the screen has been increased by one step. Also, we added one more size choice.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The behavior when I clicked the middle mouse button was strange, so I fixed it.
[/list]

We are almost ready for full release.
We've already added far more content than we did when we started early.
We plan to add BGM in the remaining period until full release.
Please look forward to the update.

notes.title: Update at the end of summer! August 30th,2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35081257/83ca207ce146c6b6ad3c94bc8bc07e772480742f.gif[/img]

Summer is almost over!
Before that, I updated a lot, so I will let you know!

[h1]Add Construction[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add Construction [b]'Fried chicken shop'[/b]
Until now, the people of the island had no way to process chicken.
But at last, he was able to build a fried chicken shop.
Thanks to the users who made this suggestion!

[*]Add Construction [b]'Pumpkin Soup Shop'[/b]
Until now, I could only eat pumpkins raw. From now on, however, by building this soup store, you can eat pumpkins more deliciously!

[*]Add a building [b]'fountain'.[/b]
Try building it around your house.
It looks cute and the environment is better!
If you build it symmetrically, it's kind of gorgeous!
[/list]

[h1]Add Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added [b]'irrigation works'[/b] to field menu.
Free rivers and ponds! It's like God's work!
A feature has been added to the Field menu to allow this.

Irrigation works artificially create water areas at specified locations.
Specify a flat area that is not adjacent to other objects.

Let's build rivers and ponds wherever you like!
Thank you to the user who made this proposal.

[*]Add a flower bed type
If various flowers bloom, it's fun just by that!

[*]Flower beds can be made on sand.
It is hoped that the sandy soil, which has been dug out of clay and has a rocky surface, will have a better view.
So I made it possible to make a flower bed in the sand!
It can be built not only on new sandy soil but also on sandy soil where you can see the rock surface after digging clay.
By the way, if you destroy the flower bed on the sandy ground, it will become sandy ground where you can see the rock surface.

[*]When transporting from the storage building by balloon, the usage status of the storage on MAP is displayed.
Now you don't have to hover over the storage.

[*]Addition of buildings [b]'public office', 'factory office', and 'ranch cooperative'.[/b]
These are facilities to provide each facility with an auto employment function.

Public offices will provide automatic employment functions at stations, balloons, ports and wharves. If culture Lv3 has built more than six of these facilities, they will be open.

The factory office provides an auto employment function to the facilities (Shoji koya, bakery, etc.) in the factory menu. It is released in culture Lv4.
(Other offices will provide an auto employment function to the facilities within the scope, but only the factory office will not be within the scope, and only the adjacent facilities will be covered.)

The farm union provides auto employment to the farm. It will be released in the second half of the game.

There have been agricultural cooperative offices before, but they have changed a little with this renewal.
The existing agricultural cooperative has been changed to a ranch cooperative.
And the new farm union was opened earlier than before, covering only the fields. (If you have built a brick factory in Culture Lv3, you will be open.)

[*]Improved fullscreen capabilities.
On a 1920 x 1080 display monitor, a new full-screen mode "FULL SCREEN1" is selected by default when you start a game.
This "FULL SCREEN1" displays more MAP objects in the screen at the correct aspect ratio.
This can be changed in the [OPTION] - [screen] - [Screen Size] menu.

The Destory tool adds the ability to cut and collect grass, trees, stones, wild vegetables and mushrooms.
Use the Destory tool to specify the grass. The unemployed people nearby will cut it right away. You can now log these objects more easily.
Please see here for details.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1087720/discussions/0/1637542851360925744/
[/list]

Now,
The number of updates has finally exceeded 200. What a shame.
I updated it very much this summer!

Taking the opportunity to achieve Ver. 200,
If anyone has not yet written a review, I would be very happy if they did.
If you write a short review, it will be a late summer treat for me!

Please continue to enjoy "Your Island -Kimi no sima-" !

notes.title: Update! August 22th , 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35081257/1630f7b7f1dea540c11ca378c2437e969ef8540d.gif[/img]

Hello everyone!
Here's what's been updated this week.

[h1]Key Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add Construction[b] 'dock'[/b]
In response to requests for more interaction with people outside the island before the appearance of the port, we added 'dock'.

This dock doesn't need fuel. We send and receive less goods than the port, but unlike the port, you can get Ark for a fee!

The seashore will surely enhance the atmosphere of the island and give people a strange encounter with adventurers coming from outside the island!


[*]An [b]announcement[/b] is now displayed in the log at the bottom left of the screen when [b]a new building is added to the menu[/b].
Thanks to the users who suggested!

[*]A new UI style has been added to make the Construction menu iconic and always visible.
You can change this style in the OPTION-SCREEN-UI menu.
In the icon style, the construction menu which is displayed by right click is arranged in the right side of the screen as an icon.
This icon always appears and you can open the menu you want at any time.

When this icon style is used, "Evolution List" and "People List" are removed from the OPTION menu and added to the icon menu.

[*]We've added the function that the screen can[b] jump to that point by clicking on the mini map [/b]in the upper right of the screen.
This feature is OFF by default.
If you want to use it, turn on Minimap Jump in the OPTION-SCREEN-UI menu.

[*][h1]Add Shortcut Key[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Z[/b]: Select 'OK button' in the message display for TIPS or events. Or, select the top item while the menu is displayed.
[*][b]X[/b]: Same as right-click

This allows you to send messages by simply pressing the Z key.
If you're hiring someone at a facility, just hit the Z key after opening the facility menu, and it's like hitting the "hire" button.
You can also press X to close the menu.

[*][b]1, 2, 3, 4[/b]: game speed change

Thank you to the user who suggested the shortcut key!
[/list]

[*]Add [b]8X speed mode[/b]
TIME IS MONEY!!
Also, it has been changed so that it stops in space during double speed mode, and when it restarts, it returns to the speed just before stopping.

[*]At the CENTER facility, you can now use the OPTION to automatically change whether or not you leave your job when you run out of materials.
The default is Separation = Permitted.
Separation = Disallowed means that you do not have to leave the job if material runs out of range.
However, for quarries, you are always separated when material runs out.
This setting is ignored for facilities with automatic employment.
This change is managed by island data.


[h1]bug fixes[/h1]
In the course of these updates, there were bugs that prevented construction and people from being hired, but they were fixed immediately. 

Thanks to the users who reported!
